data.description:
# Unchanged-plan review reuse must replay the last review's full result, notated as reused

## Current behavior (evidence)

`rebar review-plan` short-circuits when nothing the review would read has changed (both paths bypassed by `--force`):

- PASS path: `idempotent_reuse` (src/rebar/llm/plan_review/reuse.py:57-135, feature b3e5) reuses the still-valid certified attestation — but it SYNTHESIZES the returned verdict with EMPTY `blocking`/`advisory`/`coaching`/`indeterminate` lists and no counts, instead of replaying the stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar content. The CLI (`_render_plan_review_text`, src/rebar/_cli/_llm_commands.py:407-427) then prints `PLAN REVIEW: PASS`, the "reused: existing attestation is still current — no LLM re-run (pass --force to re-review)" notation, and `blocking=0 advisory=0 …` — losing whatever advisory findings and coaching the last real review actually surfaced.
- BLOCK path: `verdict_reuse` (reuse.py:138-215, bug 7e77) already replays the stored blocking/advisory/coaching from the latest sidecar plus a reused notation — this is the desired shape.

## Requested behavior (operator, 2026-08-22)

When plan review refuses to re-run because the plan is unchanged since the last review, output THE RESULT OF THE LAST REVIEW, with a notation that it is the last review's result replayed against the unchanged plan — not a fresh review. The BLOCK path already conforms; close the PASS-path gap and make the notation state what it replayed.

## Scope

1. `idempotent_reuse`: when the reuse fires, read the latest REVIEW_RESULT sidecar (it already reads it for the ticket-type check) and, when it is usable and corresponds to the same material fingerprint, populate the returned verdict's `advisory`, `coaching`, `indeterminate`, and `coverage.counts` from the stored result rather than empties. Keep the existing fail-open semantics: an unreadable/absent/mismatched sidecar degrades to the current empty-list behavior (the attestation, not the sidecar, is the validity authority — do not let a sidecar problem block a valid reuse). `blocking` stays empty on a PASS by construction; if the stored sidecar verdict contradicts (BLOCK stored but attestation valid), prefer current behavior and do not replay contradictory findings.
2. CLI notation (`_render_plan_review_text`): on either reuse path, the notation must make unmistakable that the rendered findings are the LAST review's result replayed because the plan/code are unchanged (not a fresh LLM run), and keep pointing at `--force` to re-review. Include the stored review's recency anchor if the sidecar carries one (e.g. its verified_at_sha / timestamp) so the reader can judge staleness; omit gracefully when absent.
3. JSON surface parity: the machine-readable result keeps `coverage.llm_ran=False` and the existing `idempotent_skip`/`verdict_reuse` flags; replayed findings appear in the same fields a fresh review would use. `runner="reused"` unchanged. MCP output schema must remain valid (`findings.validate_structured` already gates this — keep it passing).
4. Tests: RED first — a reuse-path test proving stored advisory/coaching are replayed on PASS reuse (currently empty), a fail-open test (sidecar unreadable → reuse still fires with empty lists), and a rendering test for the notation. Do not weaken existing b3e5/7e77 tests.

## Non-goals

- No change to WHEN reuse fires (validity rules, fingerprints, type-change invalidation stay exactly as-is).
- No change to `--force`, exit codes, signing, or sidecar emission (reuse still emits no new sidecar).
- No change to `review-plan --status`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] PASS reuse replays the stored sidecar's advisory/coaching/indeterminate + counts when the sidecar matches the current material fingerprint; degraded empty-list behavior preserved when it does not.
- [ ] Both reuse paths render a notation stating the output is the last review's result replayed against an unchanged plan, with --force pointer.
- [ ] `coverage.llm_ran=False` + reuse flags unchanged; structured validation passes.
- [ ] New tests seen RED before the fix; existing reuse tests unweakened.
data.title: Replay last review result on unchanged-plan reuse
